title: 837. Similar String Groups

examples.explanation: First three link by swaps; star is separate.
No pair is one swap apart.

hints: Two words are directly alike when their mismatch count is 0 or exactly 2 with cross-matching letters.
Join directly alike pairs with a disjoint-set union (or BFS/DFS flood fill) and count distinct roots.
Compare every pair: with n up to 300 and length up to 300 this quadratic scan is fast enough.
